description.value: A group campground on the Cowichan River — a BC and Canadian Heritage River internationally renowned for salmon and steelhead — directly adjacent to the Trans Canada Trail rail corridor, making it a natural anchor for cycling groups; group-site pricing applies a minimum charge for 15 adults.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: This is a group-only campground (OSM tag group_only=yes, confirmed by website's group camping policy requiring minimum 15 adults or 12-person youth groups). The website confirms it's part of Cowichan River Provincial Park and describes the reservation system via camping.bcparks.ca. Being group-only makes it impractical for individual touring cyclists. OSM indicates drinking water and tents allowed but no caravans, no internet access.
concerns: Group-only facility (OSM group_only=yes, confirmed by BC Parks group camping policy) — not suitable for individual cyclists
Operator phone (+1-877-559-2115 for K2 Cowichan Park Services Ltd.) not confirmed on fetched website pages
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Group-only campground requiring a minimum equivalent of 15 adult campers (or 12-person youth group). Individual touring cyclists or small groups cannot practically book or use this site.

wow_evidence: BC and Canadian Heritage River internationally renowned for salmon and steelhead... group-only campground
